title: Fix: BLOBEXT encoding is base64url not base64 (line 177)
description: RFC 9404 Section 4.1 specifies base64url encoding, not base64. Line 177 says 'it uses lowercase hex encoding rather than base64' and line 176 describes 'base64-encoded digest'. Both should say 'base64url-encoded'. These differ for digests containing + or / bits, making this a factual error in the comparison.
close_reason: Review was incorrect. RFC 9404 uses standard base64 (RFC 4648), not base64url. Example at RFC 9404 line 658 shows '/' character confirming standard base64. The draft's use of 'base64-encoded' is correct.
